name: SSH Access
description: Grants agents SSH capability through a per-host allowlist with command-pattern guardrails for remote execution.

allowedHosts.label: Allowed Hosts
allowedHosts.description: Hosts agents may SSH to, each with a short description. Empty (default) refuses every SSH invocation.

allowedCommandPatterns.label: Allowed Command Patterns
allowedCommandPatterns.description: Command-prefix patterns agents may run on the remote host. Defaults cover read-only inspection; add destructive patterns only after review.
allowedCommandPatterns.default: ls, pwd, ps, df, free, uptime, journalctl --user, systemctl --user status, docker ps, docker logs, tail -n, cat, less, head

requireKnownHosts.label: Require Known Hosts
requireKnownHosts.description: When on (default), SSH refuses hosts not already in ~/.ssh/known_hosts, preventing MITM on first connect. Off accepts new host keys silently - not recommended outside trusted networks.

onCommandRefusal.label: On Command Refusal
onCommandRefusal.description: How agents respond to a command not matching allowedCommandPatterns. refuse (default): blocks it. log-only: allows with a warning. ask: prompts the user.

timeoutSeconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds agents wait for an SSH command to return. Default 30. Lower for faster failure on hung connections; raise for known long-running commands.
